name: Paseo Colorado
description: Paseo Colorado is an upscale open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of downtown Pasadena, featuring a vibrant mix of retail shops, restaurants, and entertainment venues. Originally developed as a traditional mall and later transformed into a modern urban retail destination, the center seamlessly integrates with Pasadena's historic Old Town district. With its pedestrian-friendly design, outdoor dining spaces, and contemporary architecture, Paseo Colorado serves as a premier shopping and social destination for both locals and visitors exploring the area.
demographics: Paseo Colorado attracts an affluent, educated demographic typical of Pasadena's urban core, with visitors primarily consisting of middle to upper-income professionals, young urban families, and empty nesters aged 25-65. The trade area serves the wealthy San Gabriel Valley communities with median household incomes significantly above the national average, drawing shoppers seeking premium dining, entertainment, and specialty retail experiences. The center benefits from high foot traffic from nearby Old Pasadena attractions, corporate offices, and cultural institutions, with visitors exhibiting preferences for experiential retail, upscale casual dining, and entertainment-focused shopping trips rather than traditional mall browsing.
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in the heart of downtown Pasadena, offering a contemporary mix of retail, dining, and entertainment in a pedestrian-friendly urban setting.
